findings.title: Historical ACK shadows a later same-revision runtime read
findings.trigger: Enable receives accepted ACK with runtime ready, then the same runner becomes unavailable or maintenance changes without changing registration revision. User refreshes runtime successfully.
findings.evidence: RuntimeControls selects the ACK whenever its revision is >= the GET revision. Server plugin-runtime/store.ts runtimeView checks runner revoked/maintenance_state on every read and can change reason/bindingAllowed without incrementing registration revision.
findings.actual: UI continues displaying bindingAllowed yes / ready despite a successful more recent GET reporting host-unavailable.
findings.required: Select the newest applicable runtime observation without replacing a higher-revision ACK with a lower-revision read. Preserve UNKNOWN write identity across reads; do not conflate successful GET and mutation acceptance. Add a focused same-revision host-unavailable refresh assertion; consider an older in-flight GET arriving after an ACK.
